digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and escalation (Pass-1 ladder)
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries use bare Anthropic model names (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-8) which resolve to provider anthropic even when configured for another provider (split-brain)
ladder rungs must be expressed as class names (trivial, standard, frontier) resolved at runtime through model_classes.resolve_model_string, which already exists and is tested by f844

escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic ids for a Bedrock primary, causing silent cross-provider escalation; must map rungs through class config while preserving substring-match positioning
MODEL_LADDER table (bare names + windows) drives both escalation order and context-window budget via substring matching; must remain unchanged with no class names inserted

config.resolve_model and three batch/runner sites (production_batch_runner:93, code_review/batch_runner:55, workflow/runners.py:120) must each wire resolve_model_string; config.py import must be lazy in-body to prevent import cycle
existing couplings (orchestrator.py:72 alias, test monkeypatch at test_plan_review_prerequisites_model_log.py:43, resolve_model precedence) must be preserved byte-for-byte when no classes configured
